package http

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	private "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

type nbaContractGetter struct {
	student string
	calls   int
}

func (g *nbaContractGetter) Handle(_ context.Context, id string) (domain.StudentNextAction, error) {
	g.student = id
	g.calls++
	return domain.StudentNextAction{Schema: domain.NextActionSchema, PolicyVersion: domain.NextActionPolicyVersion, Status: "WAITING", ReasonCode: "validation_running", SecondaryActions: []domain.NextAction{}, SourceVersions: domain.NextActionVersions{StateDigest: "sha256:snapshot"}}, nil
}
func TestNextActionTrustAndPresentationContract(t *testing.T) {
	id := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	g := &nbaContractGetter{}
	r := NewRouter(RouterDependencies{AnswerHandler: &handlers.AnswerHandler{}, StudentLearningJourneyHandler: &handlers.StudentLearningJourneyHandler{NextAction: g}, InternalHandler: &private.Handler{NextAction: g}, InternalToken: "general", TeacherInternalToken: "teacher"})
	for _, c := range []struct {
		name, path, token, role, user string
		status                        int
	}{{"J_teacher", "/internal/students/" + id + "/next-action", "teacher", "", "", 200}, {"general_rejected", "/internal/students/" + id + "/next-action", "general", "", "", 403}, {"student", "/api/v1/student/next-action", "", "STUDENT", id, 200}, {"teacher_external_rejected", "/api/v1/student/next-action", "", "TEACHER", id, 403}, {"missing_identity", "/api/v1/student/next-action", "", "", "", 401}} {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, c.path, nil)
			request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", c.token)
			request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", c.user)
			request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", c.role)
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			r.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != c.status {
				t.Fatalf("got %d %s", response.Code, response.Body)
			}
			if c.status == 200 {
				if g.student != id || response.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
					t.Fatal("identity/cache contract")
				}
				var got map[string]json.RawMessage
				if json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &got) != nil || got["primary"] != nil || string(got["secondary_actions"]) != "[]" {
					t.Fatal(response.Body)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
